text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Woooo?

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what is going on here? This is slow
going,
even for a debut race...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The runners start off at such a relaxed
pace, it's
like they were going for a
stroll, not a run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But when they near the end, the speed
picks up
until the runners all hurtle past
the finish.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Trainer. I'm back from my leisurely run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I suppose she got lucky today. The other
racers
matched her pace, waiting to
speed up in the
final stretch.
choice_data_list: ああ、るんるんだったな……
うん、るんるんだったね……
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, she was skipping along happily...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But if she continues at this tempo, she'll
only be
able to go so far. It'll be difficult
to make
progress in her schedule and
races.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Trainer, is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh dearie. That sounds like I'll be racing
almost
nonstop for a while.
choice_data_list: 相談がある、今後のスケジュールのことで
相談があるの、今後のスケジュールのことで
choice_data_list_en: I have something to discuss regarding our upcoming schedule.
I'd like to discuss something about our upcoming schedule.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
You wish for me to adopt a fast-paced
schedule
so that I might adapt to the
rigor of the Twinkle
Series, no?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright's top goal is to win the
Classic
Triple Crown next year.
choice_data_list: ああ、今のままだとさすがに……
うん、今のままだとさすがに……
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, at this rate, it's gonna be tough...
Yeah, if we stay like this, it might be tough...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing wrong with doing things
at one's
own pace, but with her
easygoing demeanor, we
might run out
of time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me, Trainer. I have something to
say.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Do you truly think a schedule like that
would suit
me? I find taking things slow
and steady far more
comfortable.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps we should set our sights a little
higher.
How does the Hopeful Stakes
sound?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Why, yes! Since it is a race scheduled in

December, I can take my time training.
Plus...
choice_data_list_en: Aiming for a G1 right off the bat!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
If I compete in the Hopeful Stakes, I will
be
making the contribution I've desired
to for so
long.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Bringing honor to the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
All Umamusume in the Mejiro family are
brought
up believing that one day they
can fulfill that
promise.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"The Mejiro Umamusume are children of
light,
admired by all."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
However, because I'm so easygoing, I
haven't
managed to add even the
slightest flicker of light
to our name. Not
once in my life have I won.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
So I wish to compete as soon as I can in
a G1 and
contribute to the glory of the
Mejiros. No matter
what. At any cost.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Running the Hopeful Stakes before the
G1
Classics... It's certainly an option, but
only if she's
legitimately got a shot at
pulling it off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before I agree to anything, I need to
know that
she's capable and
determined...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The confidence... How could I possibly?

However...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...I know that I must do it. Because I am a
Mejiro.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite the ease with which she speaks,
an
intense light burns in her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's no guarantee she will win, but
she has the
purpose to try. In that case...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: You agree? Oh, what good news!
choice_data_list: わかった、じゃあ『ホープフルS』に出よう
choice_data_list_en: All right, let's enter the Hopeful Stakes then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Without question, I will endeavor to run

satisfactorily and produce a shining light
for the
Mejiro name.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her feelings persuade me to take this
small risk...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But preparing for the G1 Hopeful Stakes
won't be
easy.
